# gsm_game_server_cluster_policy (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_name` (String) Name of the game server cluster the policy belongs to
- `policy_name` (String) Name of the policy

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `actions` (List of String) List of actions permitted or denied by the policy
- `effect` (String) Policy effect: 'allow' or 'deny'
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `objects` (List of String) List of objects governed by the policy
- `subjects` (List of String) List of subjects the policy applies to
